title: Hamilton, OH — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Hamilton, OH: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Hamilton is a city in OH with a population of 62,000. Greater Cincinnati city with the Fitton Center and a historic downtown revival. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.7.
